artists.source_line: The Angolan Dances Trip is an immersive cultural experience created by Lápis Eventos, led by Gabriel Cabinda, the producer behind the internationally recognized Angolan Dances Festival (Lisbon).

features.quote: Dance workshops (Kizomba, Semba, Kuduro & traditional dances)
features.rationale: The list of inclusions names dance workshops in several styles as part of the trip.

features.quote: Intensive training: 1 hour/day in small groups
features.rationale: The description offers intensive daily training in small groups.

features.quote: Live music, backyard parties & street celebrations
features.rationale: Live music is listed as one of the included experiences.

features.quote: Includes accommodation, transport, activities & 2 meals per day
features.rationale: The Package 1 price explicitly includes accommodation.
